title: Holmes Extra-Large Pebbled Leather Convertible Messenger Bag
description_html:
Holmes Extra-Large Pebbled Leather Convertible Messenger Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 16.5”W X 11”H X 5.5”D
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Pebbled leather
  • Hardware: Antique gold-tone hardware
  • Closure: Snap fastening
